## Technology adapters

A few adapters below (Diagram, EMF, OWL, HTTP, JDBC, PDF, Kafka) link to a per-component
mini-site — content from 2023–2024, describing an older version of Openflexo, not being rebuilt
yet. Every other adapter links straight to its source repository instead. Status reflects the
architecture board's review of 2026-04-03; see the [repository map](./repository-map) for every
repository grouped by architectural role instead of by status.

### Stabilised

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| [XML/XSD](https://github.com/openflexo-team/openflexo-xml) | XML documents, typed against an XSD or freely structured |
| [EMF](https://openflexo.org/openflexo-emf/) | EMF-based metamodels and models |
| [OWL](https://openflexo.org/openflexo-owl/) | OWL2 ontologies |
| [Diagram](https://openflexo.org/openflexo-diagram/) | Openflexo's native diagramming technology |
| [M/S Word](https://github.com/openflexo-team/openflexo-docx) | Microsoft Word documents (.doc, .docx) |
| [M/S Excel](https://github.com/openflexo-team/openflexo-xlsx) | Microsoft Excel spreadsheets (.xls, .xlsx) |

| [JDBC](https://openflexo.org/openflexo-jdbc/) | Relational databases via JDBC |
| [M/S PowerPoint](https://github.com/openflexo-team/openflexo-pptx) | Microsoft PowerPoint presentations (.ppt, .pptx) |
